note: Tier-A local open-weight catalog read by modelhub.model.search. Sizes are nominal param counts (active params for MoE); on-disk size depends on quant (see modelhub.fit.score). `repo` is the HuggingFace download path; `ollama` (when present) is the `ollama pull` tag. Every download/fetch is gated by the engine-bridge nemesis runner (C4/C5), fail-closed. A `non-commercial` tag flags research/NC licenses — review before commercial use. Each model carries `arch` (verified architecture) + `resource` (precomputed RAM/CPU/GPU demand at Q4_K_M: min_ram_gb, gpu_min_vram_gb, cpu_ok, tier, needs_offload + a one-line `resource.label` shown beside the descriptor). See model-arch.json + MDS/model-resource-methodology.md for the formula.
